en:
As the Amago and the Ouchi
kept each other in check,
Motonari resolved to accept
the marriage to Lady Myo.


Wary of the Amago and Ouchi,
the Mouri prepared the wedding,
and in early spring, under cherry
blossoms, the bride arrived.

By taking Lady Myo as his wife,
Motonari brought the Mouri under
the Amago banner. Lady Myo soon
conceived her first child, and the
ties between the Amago, Mouri and
Kikkawa grew deeper. Ouchi Yoshioki,
judging the time not yet ripe to
fight the Amago, let it pass in
silence, and the standoff between
the two went on.


And so, a year later...
